subject: Merge dataframes problem with sort and duplicates

messages.author: 7cefeb3a62ea5b10
messages.subject: Merge dataframes problem with sort and duplicates
parts:
Hi all,

I have sorting and duplicate problems with merge.
I am merging two dataframes, e.g.,

ratings<- data.frame(item=c(1, 2, 3, 4), rating=c(-1, -2, -3, -4))
choices<- data.frame(item_L=c(3,4,1,2, 1, 2), item_R=c(4, 3,2,1, 2, 1))

item_L and item_R are actually the same as item, but with the indicator left and right (in stimulus presentation).Critically, there are more choices than ratings and the same choice pairings can occur several times.
what I did so far:

## merge left data
xx= merge(choices,ratings,by.x='item_L', by.y='item' , sort=F)
## merge right data
yy= merge(choices ,ratings,by.x='item_R', by.y='item', sort=F)

my first problem occurs here: somehow R sorts them, although it is turned off. suddenly, the sequence 3,4,1,2,1,2 becomes the sequence 3,4,1,1,2,2.

## now bind left and right data
g<- merge(xx,yy,by=c("item_L", 'item_R'), sort=F)
g

Now there are too many rows and duplicates.
I read in ?merge that:
If there is more than one match, all possible matches contribute one row each. Is there a way to turn that off? Or are there other possibilities? join (Plyr) did not help me either..

Thanks a lot for any suggestions.

Would it be acceptable in a slightly longer format? 

I'm not terribly great with tidyr/reshape2 so I'm struggling to get it all the way back out to what you've requested.

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

ratings<- data.frame(item=c(1, 2, 3, 4), rating=c(-1, -2, -3, -4)) 
choices<- data.frame(item_L=c(3,4,1,2, 1, 2), item_R=c(4, 3,2,1, 2, 1))

gather(choices, "Type", "item", 1:2) %>%
inner_join(., ratings)

B
